metric_definitions.label: Faithfulness
metric_definitions.meaning: Existing native judge estimate of answer claims supported by the same rendered evidence; not deterministic claim verification.

metric_definitions.label: Answer relevancy
metric_definitions.meaning: Existing native judge estimate of how well the answer addresses the question against ground truth.

metric_definitions.label: Context precision
metric_definitions.meaning: Existing native judge estimate of the fraction of retrieved chunks useful for the answer.

metric_definitions.label: Citation index validity
metric_definitions.meaning: Fraction of Source N references whose indices exist in the rendered evidence; not claim support.

metric_definitions.label: Keyword recall proxy
metric_definitions.meaning: Fraction of explicit required keywords found in rendered evidence; not Recall@K or semantic relevance.

metric_definitions.label: Fallback correctness
metric_definitions.meaning: Whether the answer's existing insufficient-information fallback phrase matches the case expectation.
